PostSummary: Rapid-fire clips list verses that supposedly contradict each other, edited for maximum shock in under a minute, with no time for context, genre, or the original languages. The format rewards the gotcha, not the answer.
BiblicalResponse: A sixty-second clip is not enough time to settle whether an ancient library of sixty-six books agrees with itself. Many supposed contradictions dissolve when you read the full passage, note who is speaking, and allow different authors to describe the same event from different angles. If a clip troubles you, slow down: read the passage in context, consult a trusted commentary, and ask a pastor. Truth is not afraid of examination.
